text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chairs cabinet meeting on National Solidarity Fund activities. Fund, aimed at helping rural poor, has disbursed 194 million dinars since it was established in 1993.
- Brahim Fridhi named chairman of Tunisian news agency TAP.
- Japan grants Tunisia 17.3 billion yen loan.
- Budget of National Solidarity Fund for 1997 set at 78 million dinars.
